fomod.Name: Precision Physic Bodies
fomod.Author: mad72
fomod.Description: A complete rebuild of Skyrim VR's NPC Havok bodies. Joints that track the XP32 skeleton, collision capsules that fit the actual body mesh, both refitted live at runtime. 18 joints and ~148 capsules instead of 19, fitted per NPC by ReScale and ReShape. 2.0: male bodies (human, khajiit, argonian), genital collision with touch-driven erection (SPS/TNG), and a front-neck choking capsule on every skeleton. 2.1: during an OStim scene every body is switched to keyframed motion, so it tracks the animation exactly and cannot be shoved -- fixing scene alignment while still allowing touch. 2.1.1 extends that to NPC-vs-NPC scenes and fixes a crash at scene end. 2.2: push and shove with four separate install choices (push walk, push stumble, shove knockdown, leg sweep knockdown) that leave busy NPCs alone (seated, sleeping, working a crafting station) and brace leaning ones against pushes but not sweeps; hand equip and undress gestures as an install choice with no on-screen messages; a mouth-to-lips kiss contact for touch-event mods; the female (futa) genital rig on by default.
